instructions: Open the MCP manager for your Antigravity surface: CLI `/mcp`, App Customizations → Installed → MCP Servers, or the IDE MCP Store.
Find `decision-ops-mcp`, enable it if disabled, and complete its authentication prompt and browser consent.
If the session is stale, reconnect this server in the MCP manager, then retry the interrupted request.
Client versions and OAuth registration support vary. Verify a real search in the intended organization and project before treating setup as complete.

triggers.label: Toggle server in MCP Store
triggers.hint: Open your Antigravity MCP manager (CLI `/mcp`, App Customizations, or IDE MCP Store), select `decision-ops-mcp`, and complete its authentication prompt.

triggers.label: Toggle off/on
triggers.hint: Reconnect `decision-ops-mcp` in your MCP manager, then retry the interrupted request.

instructions: Inside Claude Code, run the `/mcp` slash command.
Select `decision-ops-mcp` from the list, then choose `Authenticate`.
Approve the consent screen at auth.aidecisionops.com in your browser.
To clear a stale session, run `/mcp` and choose `Clear authentication` for the same server before retrying.

triggers.label: Authenticate via /mcp
triggers.hint: Inside Claude Code, run `/mcp`, select `decision-ops-mcp`, choose `Authenticate`.

triggers.label: Clear stale session
triggers.hint: Inside Claude Code, run `/mcp`, select `decision-ops-mcp`, choose `Clear authentication`.

instructions: Run `codex mcp login decision-ops-mcp` to trigger the OAuth flow in your browser.
Approve the consent screen at auth.aidecisionops.com.
If authentication is already cached against a stale URL, run `codex mcp logout decision-ops-mcp` first.
Open Cursor MCP settings (Tools & MCP or Customize, depending on version) and enable `decision-ops-mcp` if disabled.
Follow the server authentication prompt, complete DecisionOps browser sign-in and consent, and retry an interrupted request.
For stale credentials, use the available sign-out or reconnect controls for this server. A global token reset affects other MCP connections too.

triggers.label: Toggle server to trigger OAuth
triggers.hint: Open Cursor MCP settings, select `decision-ops-mcp`, and follow its authentication prompt.

triggers.label: Reconnect stale session
triggers.hint: Use the available sign-out or reconnect controls for `decision-ops-mcp`. A global token reset affects every MCP server.

instructions: Open Command Palette (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P) → `MCP: List Servers`, select `decision-ops-mcp`, then `Start Server` to trigger OAuth.
Approve the consent screen at auth.aidecisionops.com in your browser.
To clear a stale session, select `decision-ops-mcp` in `MCP: List Servers` → `Disconnect Account` before starting the server again.
Requires VS Code 1.102+ (built-in MCP). Account-level management: Accounts menu → `Manage Trusted MCP Servers`.

triggers.label: Start server to trigger OAuth
triggers.hint: Open Command Palette (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P) → `MCP: List Servers` → select `decision-ops-mcp` → `Start Server`. Requires VS Code 1.102+.

triggers.label: Disconnect account
triggers.hint: Open Command Palette (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P) → `MCP: List Servers` → select `decision-ops-mcp` → `Disconnect Account`, then start the server again.
